description: B2B SaaS web MVP for small stand assembly/disassembly agencies and event technical providers.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold
scales.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-semibold

layouts.spacing_system: Use generous spacing. Tailwind scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (e.g., p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-6. Use full height for children.
layouts.landing_bento: Tetris Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12, gap-8. Aggressive asymmetry, overlapping elements.
layouts.alignment: Mobile-first standard. Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content/forms. Explicit alignment, avoid center-everything.

grids.bento_grid: Use for landing page features. Mix 3+ shapes (Hero, Square, Tall, Filler). Never fill 100% perfectly, leave breathing room.
grids.admin_grid: Strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact. Use border-collapse style layout for data tables or stacked cards on mobile.

surfaces.neumorphism: Not recommended for this B2B profile. Stick to Flat/Crisp.
surfaces.grid_borders: For Admin tables: border-r border-b border-gray-200.

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first. All designs must start with mobile layout in mind (e.g. w-full, flex-col, grid-cols-1).
responsive.layout: Use stacked cards instead of data tables for mobile screens (<768px). Use bottom tab bars or compact lateral menus. The mobile intervenant confirmation page must be ultra-simple with 100vh layout.
responsive.typography: Scale down headings on mobile. Base body text remains text-base (16px) to prevent zooming on inputs.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure max-w-full and overflow-x-hidden on root containers to prevent horizontal scroll.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all buttons and interactive elements. Intervenant mobile app needs MASSIVE buttons (e.g. h-20, text-2xl).

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA minimums (4.5:1 for body text). NEVER use gray-on-gray for vital info.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden='true' on decorative icons. Ensure all buttons have descriptive text or aria-labels.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have a visible focus state with higher contrast.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).

media.icons: Use `lucide-react` for crisp, consistent UI icons.
media.images: Use realistic, professional photos of event setups, staging, and technical crews.

hero_landing.description: Technician managing sound and lighting panels during an outdoor event. Use as landing page hero background with a bg-black/40 overlay.

feature_stage.description: Stage set with chairs and tables under blue spotlights. Use in 'How it works' or features section.

testimonial_worker.description: Smiling man standing behind delivery truck. Use as an avatar for the agency manager testimonial.

component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn JS form components (Input, Select, Checkbox). Customize with brand colors and 4px radii.
component_instructions.tables: For desktop dashboard, use HTML/Tailwind tables or Shadcn Table. For mobile, use flex-col mapped cards.
component_instructions.buttons: Shadcn Button. Modify to be crisp and professional. Primary action is Blue, Danger is Red, Success is Green. Mobile confirmation buttons must be extremely large (h-24, w-full, text-3xl font-black).
component_instructions.drag_drop: Implement simple drag & drop for the 'priority order' selection of intervenants.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building ShiftFlow, a B2B SaaS for event technical providers.
MANDATORY: You have .js files, NOT .tsx files. Use standard JSX/JS syntax. Create all components as .js or .jsx.
MANDATORY: Build mobile-first. Default to stack layouts (`flex-col`, `grid-cols-1`) and use `md:` or `lg:` for desktop overrides.
MANDATORY: Implement `data-testid` on EVERY button, input, link, and interactive widget.

MANDATORY: The mobile intervenant confirmation page (public) MUST be brutally simple. Just the mission details and two MASSIVE buttons ('J'ACCEPTE', 'JE REFUSE') taking up 50% of the screen each. No login required.
MANDATORY: Never use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or sticky headers over content. Always use solid white or glassmorphism.
MANDATORY: Avoid 'AI slop' center-everything designs. Use left alignment for text, clear grids, and professional padding.
MANDATORY: The boss dashboard should show clear, color-coded statuses (Confirmed, Contacted, Waiting, Refused, Cancelled) using the provided status colors.
MANDATORY: Do not use placeholder images. Use the exact URLs from the `image_urls` object.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only for headers/modals.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-transform` or `transition-colors`.
Never center align the main app container globally.
Always use modern, crisp button styles with interaction animations (hover/focus).
Never use emoji characters for icons. Use `lucide-react`.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Avoid cramped layouts.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Found in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js` (or similar).
